prompt: Our product is a network firewall appliance with a management app. How does the CRA classify it and what conformity route do we need?
assertions: Uses the CRA classification tiers: default category, Important Class I, Important Class II, and critical products — and identifies a firewall as an Important product (Class II per Annex III/IV structure)

Explains the conformity-assessment consequence: default products may self-assess (internal control); Class I needs harmonised standards or third-party assessment; Class II requires third-party (notified body) conformity assessment
Covers Annex I essential requirements at a high level (secure-by-default, vulnerability handling, SBOM, support period)
Notes CE marking + technical documentation + EU declaration of conformity obligations from the December 11, 2027 application date
Mentions that no CRA harmonised standards are cited in the OJ yet / standards are in development — so conformity planning should not assume a presumption-of-conformity shortcut today
